minutes.headline: Personnel Committee approved hiring Sue Byrne as the town's first full-time principal assessor at grade 15, step 4.
minutes.summary: The committee, run by the vice-chair with no chair present, approved the April minutes and a personnel action form hiring a principal assessor after the outside assessing firm ended its services. Staff said a fall Town Meeting article is needed to put the grade into the bylaw. Members thanked the departing chair and a retiring town official, and said the board will be realigned at the next meeting.

public_comment.topic: Donna Fortune introduced as someone interested in becoming a member of the Personnel Committee; she attended as a participant.

A letter will be written on behalf of the committee thanking the outgoing chair for his service.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee took a roll-call vote on a personnel action form hiring a principal assessor at grade 15, step 4; the tally was not audible.
Staff said the grade 15 classification must go to the fall Town Meeting as an article; the warrant opens at the start of September and closes at the end.
The outside assessing firm said a full-time assessor would be cost prohibitive, did not respond to the RFP, and ended its services on June 30.
A member asked about a budget surplus now that the position is filled in-house; another recalled the move was expected to cost about the same or save money.
Realigning the board, including a new chair, was set as the first item on the next agenda; a thank-you letter to the outgoing chair will be written.

why_it_matters: Assessing, which sets the property values behind tax bills, moves from an outside firm to a town employee, and the pay grade needs Town Meeting approval through a bylaw article that residents may be asked to vote on.
watch_next: The fall Town Meeting warrant article placing the principal assessor in grade 15; the warrant opens at the beginning of September and closes at the end of September.
The next Personnel Committee agenda, where realigning the board is the first item.
